title: docs(objectql): query-syntax.mdx §9 still declares the all-unknown projection fallback that #27165 / PR #27541 refused
body:
triage#1 · os-zhuang · session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U

**Filing gate ①**, the review after landing of PR #27541 (maintainer ruling #27345: a PR that landed owing a review is reviewed on its landed head, and each must-fix becomes a new card). The FAIL record is comment 6497589244 on PR #27541, merge commit `ee9a8d6e`. ⛔ Not a claim.

## The defect

**Must-fix 1 — the published protocol page still declares the capability this PR retired, for exactly the callers it affects.** `content/docs/protocol/objectql/query-syntax.mdx` §9 "Unknown Fields Are Tolerated", on `origin/main` L1487-1507, says: L1489 "Unknown field names are not rejected by `engine.find()`", and in its callout L1503-1506 "a projection left with no known field falls all the way back to every field. The engine's tolerance guards internal callers (hooks, flows, expand sub-reads, registry-less hosts) that never pass through that ingress." After `ee9a8d6e` that sentence is false for `find` / `findOne` on a registered object: the all-unknown case is refused `400 VALIDATION_ERROR` (engine.ts L13639, L13944), and only the mixed case is tolerated. A hook or flow author reading the protocol page is taught the one shape the engine now refuses. A retirement is the declaration and the code together; the `Skills-docs:` line names only `queries.mdx`. The prior record named this page explicitly; the delta commit did not touch it.

## Done when

§9's lead sentence and callout say that an unknown plain column is dropped only while at least one requested column is known; that a projection whose every entry is unknown is refused by `engine.find()` / `findOne()` with `400 VALIDATION_ERROR` naming the requested columns, the same refusal as `fields: []` (#27008, #27165); that `expand` sub-reads are unaffected because they always name `id`; and that the REST ingress still answers `400 INVALID_FIELD` for any unknown name. The "falls all the way back to every field" clause reads as the closed history it is or is removed. `git grep -n "falls all the way back" content/docs` returns nothing, `Build Docs` and `Check Documentation Links` are green on the fix PR, and the fix PR's `Skills-docs:` line names this page. Prose-only, `skip-changeset`, no code.

**Triage grade:** p2 · `domain:devx` (`content/docs/**`) · `area:api`. A published protocol page teaches a hook or flow author the one shape the engine now refuses (「写给 AI 的文档与 skills 说错一句，等于产品缺陷」).
